bank_definition.late_elite: all native top30 in argsort objective order
bank_definition.late_non_elite: last actually evaluated iteration; complement of native top30; indices linspace(0,269,170,dtype=int)

cost_calibration.anchor2_prefix_basis: prefix+5 future blocks: anchor1=10 blocks and anchor2=15 blocks, so 1.5x physical replay cost when calibration is anchor1
cost_calibration.conservative_estimate_formula: 1.2*(elapsed_through_calibration + 15*physical_context_seconds*anchor2_prefix_multiplier + 16*(cold_forward+history_forward+truth_encoder)) + 300s teardown/stageout reserve; the cost-only first forward is not retained for mechanism metrics
